summary: Took ownership of building and optimising a responsive multi-page marketing website, using VueJS, Nuxt 3 and Bootstrap-Vue/Bootstrap-Vue-Next, with a strong focus on SEO, performance, and cross-device compatibility. Worked closely with senior leadership to define and prioritise website objectives, converting strategic requirements into deliverables completed ahead of schedule.

Delivered visual design assets (posters, animations, and video content) for a government-affiliated creative studio, supporting multiple public sector organisations. Managed social media publishing strategy alongside fellow co-workers by analysing timing, platforms, and audience engagement to maximise content reach.

Co-directing and managing a team developing a Mario & Luigi fangame, serving as Lead 3D Artist responsible for asset creation, task management, and project organization to ensure consistent progress and quality.
